verdict.rationale: Headless or CI-driven automation is a fair question for a government filing service, which could offer an API or programmatic filing, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no such capability: no OpenAPI spec was found, and the bizfile portal sits behind an Incapsula bot-management shell. New User Access requirements also gate filings behind entity-linked accounts. Bulk-data files and downloadable notary lists are adjacent data exports, not a way to run the product headlessly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
